items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: He fascinated me when I was a kid, because he was coming to see my aunt, my mother's younger sister, Aunt Cissy, who we called Alberta.

ctx.x: I mean, it was limited what you could do in the South. Limited.

He fascinated me when I was a kid, because he was coming to see my aunt, my mother's younger sister, Aunt Cissy, who we called Alberta. And we didn't have any of this; all we had was church people around there.
